project_type: Next.js 16 App Router web app (El-Kema learning platform). Server Components by default; client components marked "use client". Atomic design: ui (atoms) -> molecules -> organisms -> _sections -> pages.
build_system: pnpm (packageManager pnpm@11.1.1). Tailwind v4 via @import in src/app/globals.css (no tailwind.config); tw-animate-css imported there too. Theme tokens are oklch CSS vars mapped through @theme inline. Turbopack.
test_framework: vitest (jsdom) + @testing-library/react + @testing-library/user-event. Test files colocated as *.test.tsx next to source.
test_command: pnpm run test   (runs `vitest run`; target one file with `pnpm run test <path>`)
verification_instructions: From repo root d:\devs\El-Kema-platform (PowerShell, use ';' not '&&'): `pnpm run typegen`; `pnpm run typecheck`; `pnpm run lint` (0 errors); `pnpm run test` (keep green); `pnpm run build`. Typecheck was green on main at planning time. For UI, compare against Figma file y0eOLyKLtTHnJYzOW046WR nodes 624:3480 (Home) and 451:1151 (Navbar) via the figma power get_screenshot; reason about LTR mirroring since logical properties mirror automatically.
snapshot_or_generated_files: `pnpm run typegen` (next typegen) regenerates .next/types used by typecheck/PageProps; run it before typecheck. No committed snapshots.
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell: chain with ';', not '&&'. Use pnpm, NEVER npm. PowerShell globbing breaks on the literal `[locale]` path segment — use -LiteralPath for ls, and the read/edit/grep tools for file ops. pnpm's PowerShell banner prints to stderr (harmless; check exit code, not stderr text).
contribution_requirements: Do NOT modify design tokens (globals.css vars) or the font. Do NOT rebuild the Landing Page. Logical direction utilities ONLY (ps/pe/ms/me/start/end, text-start/text-end) — never left/right/ml/mr/pl/pr/text-left/text-right. Support light + dark (next-themes class). Respect prefers-reduced-motion for any animation. Keep ar.json + en.json in sync (ar is default/RTL, en is LTR). The organisms messages-parity test enforces parity for the `organisms` namespace only; `home` parity must be kept manually. Compose existing atoms/molecules/organisms; extend a shared component only if needed and keep it backward-compatible (grep call sites first). `cn` helper at @/lib/utils/cn.
key_patterns: Section wrappers are server components that own an i18n namespace and feed prop-driven presentational organisms. Buttons: <Button appearance='filled|outline|ghost' variant='primary|secondary|destructive|inverse' size='sm|md|lg|icon'>; use asChild to wrap the i18n Link from @/lib/i18n/navigation for navigation. Routes come from @/config/routes (routes.courses, routes.teachers, routes.login, routes.register). Icons from @/components/icons (e.g. RightArrowIcon, GraduationIcon, PersonIcon, SearchIcon). Animation: use Tailwind `animate-spin` + `motion-reduce:animate-none` (tw-animate-css already imported) — no new @keyframes, no token edits. The ProgressRing already has role=progressbar + aria-value* + an i18n accessible name via useTranslations('molecules').progress.
directory_structure: src/app/[locale]/(public)/ = public site: page.tsx is the Home route (/), _sections/ holds the five section wrappers. src/components/ui = atoms (button, badge, input, sheet). src/components/molecules = accordion, progress-ring, search (index.ts barrel). src/components/organisms = media-info-card, offer-card, progress-tracking-card, faq-section (index.ts barrel). src/components/shared = navbar, nav-links, logo, theme-toggle, locale-switcher. src/components/icons = semantic re-exports of lucide. messages/ = ar.json (default/RTL) + en.json (LTR). Figma source-of-truth docs under .agents/design-system/.
